## Change summary and scope
What resources or behaviors change, and why? Is this an ordinary edit, a method change, a proposed governing amendment, or a scientific interpretation?

## Applicable authority and status
- [ ] Linked charter provision or valid delegation; otherwise explicitly marked unapproved
- [ ] Proposal/decision/ratified status stated accurately; no inference of binding meaning from merge
- [ ] Linked Issues and primary evidence; alternatives and dissent preserved

## Cross-domain effects
- [ ] Affected roles, skills, indexes, documents, tasks, protocols and decisions identified
- [ ] Each dependency has an owner and disposition (updated / not affected / blocked)
- [ ] New/moved directories have a parent-linked README and navigation index
- [ ] Historical sources, current summaries and proposed changes remain distinguishable

## Verification
Tests actually performed (commands or reviewer walkthrough, outputs, observed failures, current branch SHA); human workflow and cold-start behavior where relevant; untested claims explicitly listed.

## Decision
Reviewer authority, objections, requested changes, who may enact, and intended stage. The Research Director retains charter and outset gate authority.
